items.title: 12.11 Sulfur aur us ke compounds ke istemalat (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 12.11 heading, printed page 283.

blocks.text: Sulfur aur us ke compounds sanat aur rozmarra zindagi mein istemal hote hain: rubber ki vulcanisation (12.11.1), fertiliser (12.11.2) aur gunpowder (12.11.3) mein, saath sulfuric acid (12.13) aur drugs, dyes aur fragrances ki organic synthesis (12.12) mein. Sulfur dioxide aur sulfite salts khurak mehfooz rakhne mein bhi istemal hote hain.

blocks.prompt: Khurak mehfooz rakhne mein SO2 aur sulfite salts ka kya kaam hai (Quick Check 12.5a)?
blocks.explanation: Yeh reducing agents aur antimicrobials hain: yeh khushk phal, juices aur wine ke oxidative bhoora hone aur rang badalne ko rokte hain aur bacteria, yeasts aur moulds ki barhotri rokte hain, to khurak zyada der tik-ti hai.

items: Istemalat: vulcanisation, fertiliser, gunpowder, sulfuric acid, drugs, dyes, fragrances; SO2 aur sulfites khurak mehfooz rakhte hain.
